summary: Only one file changed: the new tests/advice/postflop-coverage.acceptance.test.ts (110 lines, within the 130-line budget). src/, the locked postflop.acceptance.test.ts, postflop.test.ts and docs have no diff against base 3f1669f. I checked with Node that every pinned input gives a value 0.1 lower without the + 1e-9 nudge, so removing the nudge fails all twelve cases, not only the first. It repeats every assertion from the locked AC#3 property and adds the street-equality and rounded-comparison rule checks. The coverage counters (streets, foldedSeatRuns, discards) are asserted after fc.assert with the specified values, and the discard counter sits right before fc.pre(state.toAct !== null). The test file passes locally (2/2, AC#2 in about 0.5 s). The gate build-1 passed test, lint, typecheck and the scope checks. No helpers, comments or dead code beyond what the spec asks for. The duplicated setup (STAKES_4_8, SEATS, ALL_CARDS) is the copy the spec requires, because the source file is locked and exports nothing.
